'''''Carex elata''''' (common name, '''tufted sedge'''), is a species of tussock-forming, grass-like plant in the [[Cyperaceae]] family. It is native to all of Europe, the Atlas Mountains of Africa, Turkey, Iran and Central Asia.<ref name="299596-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:299596-1 |title=''Carex elata'' All. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=27 September 2020 }}</ref> 

== Description ==
''Carex elata'' is a tussock-forming, evergreen [[perennial]], growing to 1.2 m (4ft) by 1.5 m (5ft). Foliage is bright gold, with green margins.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tufted Sedge (Carex elata (Carex stricta))-Hort Answers - University of Illinois Extension |url=https://web.extension.illinois.edu/hortanswers/PlantDetail.cfm?PlantID=600&PlantTypeID=3 |access-date=2024-11-12 |website=web.extension.illinois.edu}}</ref> It flowers from May to June, and seeds ripen from July to August. The species is [[Monecious|monoecious]] (individual flowers are either male or female, but both sexes can be found on the same plant).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Carex elata Tufted Sedge, Golden Variegated Sedge, Tufted Sedge PFAF Plant Database |url=https://pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Carex+elata |access-date=2024-11-12 |website=pfaf.org}}</ref> 

Its cultivar 'Aurea' has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Carex elata'' 'Aurea' Bowles' golden sedge |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/89736/Carex-elata-Aurea/Details |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |accessdate=27 September 2020 |quote=Synonyms ''Carex stricta'' 'Bowles's Variety'; ''Carex stricta'' 'Bowles's Golden'; ''Carex'' 'Bowles Golden'; ''Carex stricta'' 'Aurea'; ''Carex elata'' 'Bowles's Golden'; ''Carex riparia'' 'Bowles's Golden' }}</ref>

== Distribution and habitat ==
''Carex elata'' grows best in nutrient-rich, wetland conditions, such as marshes, fens, wet woods, and shallow water margins.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TUFTED SEDGE Carex elata |url=https://celticwildflowers.co.uk/products/tufted-sedge-carex-elata#:~:text=Tussock%20forming%20perennial%20grass%20found,nutrient-rich%20fens%20and%20mires. |access-date=2024-11-12 |website=Celtic Wildflowers |language=en}}</ref>
